description: This source file defines a REST API resource class for retrieving entity field configuration data related to addresses within the Fineract project. It handles HTTP GET requests to fetch configuration details for specified entities, enabling dynamic field management and validation.

classes.name: EntityFieldConfigurationApiResource
classes.description: A REST controller class that provides APIs to fetch entity field configuration data, secured by permission checks, and capable of serving JSON responses.

methods.name: getAddresses
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve field configuration data for a given entity, verifying permissions and returning a list of configuration data objects.
